tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund only units received back; customer wants to return whole order, including an item not yet returned; must arrive first; refund window timing."}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v2/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units: if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks; if the customer will send them later, the assistant explains that they must arrive first and requests nothing for them now."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/amount", "title": "Refund amount", "text": "The refund for a unit is what was paid for that unit: its price minus its share of any discount. The shares are fixed once, when the order is recorded, and never recalculated: when a paid total is split among identical units, each unit gets the total divided by the number of units, rounded down to the smallest unit of the currency, and what is left over is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units, so no unit is refunded more than its price. Shipping charges are not part of the amount. A unit for which nothing was paid has nothing to refund: a request that includes it is refused, and the other units can be requested without it. Nobody can raise the amount, so a request for more than was paid is refused with this reason."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v2/payout", "title": "When the money is paid", "text": "The shop pays a refund only when all of these hold: the order qualifies, the request was on time, the units were received back and not refunded before, the order has one valid payment, the customer confirmed, a staff member approved, and the proposal is still valid. The refund is complete only when the customer has a receipt; until then nothing is reported as refunded. In this demonstration a receipt records the refund in the shop's test ledger: it is not a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for the money to appear on a card."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
